Title: New Quick Action Transformations Added to Data Factory Mapping Data Flows

Body.Content:
A new feature called "Quick Actions" has been added to ADF Mapping Data Flows:

From the Data Flow transformation Data Preview panel, you can now interact with your live data and choose transformation actions, data types, and column selections. ADF will then produce the subsequent transformations and expressions to produce the results for you that you've chosen from the data preview menu. This feature makes it super easy for you to begin transforming your big data at scale without writing any code or expressions. Simply select your data, point to the transformations you'd like to perform, and let ADF build the data flow steps for you.
